events.title: Legendary founding of Japan by Emperor Jimmu
events.description: According to the 8th-century chronicles, Jimmu, said to descend from the sun goddess Amaterasu, became Japan's first emperor on this day. The legend is commemorated as National Foundation Day.
events.html: According to the 8th-century chronicles, Jimmu, said to descend from the sun goddess Amaterasu, became Japan's first emperor on this day. The legend is commemorated as National Foundation Day.

events.title: English clergy recognise Henry VIII as head of the Church
events.description: Under threat of prosecution, the Convocation of Canterbury acknowledged Henry as Supreme Head of the Church in England 'as far as the law of Christ allows'. The full break with Rome followed by 1534.
events.html: Under threat of prosecution, the Convocation of Canterbury acknowledged Henry as Supreme Head of the Church in England 'as far as the law of Christ allows'. The full break with Rome followed by 1534.

events.title: Pennsylvania Hospital, the first in the American colonies, opens
events.description: Founded by Benjamin Franklin and Dr Thomas Bond, the Pennsylvania Hospital admitted its first patients in Philadelphia. It was the first hospital in what became the United States.
events.html: Founded by Benjamin Franklin and Dr Thomas Bond, the Pennsylvania Hospital admitted its first patients in Philadelphia. It was the first hospital in what became the United States.

events.title: Thomas Edison is born in Milan, Ohio
events.description: Edison patented more than 1,000 inventions, including the phonograph and a practical incandescent lamp. His laboratory at Menlo Park pioneered organised industrial research.
events.html: Edison patented more than 1,000 inventions, including the phonograph and a practical incandescent lamp. His laboratory at Menlo Park pioneered organised industrial research.

events.title: Bernadette Soubirous sees her first vision at Lourdes
events.description: The 14-year-old miller's daughter reported seeing a lady in white in the grotto of Massabielle. Lourdes grew into one of the most visited Catholic pilgrimage sites in the world.
events.html: The 14-year-old miller's daughter reported seeing a lady in white in the grotto of Massabielle. Lourdes grew into one of the most visited Catholic pilgrimage sites in the world.

events.title: Lateran Treaty creates Vatican City
events.description: Mussolini's government and the Holy See agreed to recognise Vatican City as an independent state. The treaty ended the 'Roman Question' that had divided Church and Italian state since 1870.
events.html: Mussolini's government and the Holy See agreed to recognise Vatican City as an independent state. The treaty ended the 'Roman Question' that had divided Church and Italian state since 1870.

events.title: Nelson Mandela walks free after 27 years in prison
events.description: Mandela left Victor Verster Prison near Paarl hand in hand with his wife Winnie, watched by millions on television. Four years later he was elected South Africa's first Black president.
